name: Deena Valietta
original_name: ディーナ・ヴァリエッタ
source:
The owner, who also in-charge of the security of "Alcatraz", a luxury inn that boasts ironclad security.
She keeps a vigilant watch both inside and outside of the inn's high, prison-like walls every day.
A strict woman who is a former mercenary.
